# CV Studio

> CV Studio is a free CV and resume builder with PDF/DOCX export and a document reader that helps map information from supported job-application documents into a profile on the user's device. No sign-up is needed to try the editor. Clean downloads and paid usage credits follow the plans shown on the site.

## Key facts
- Create, edit and preview a CV without signing in.
- Choose plain or designed CV templates.
- Download PDF or DOCX (Word); free sample downloads may be watermarked.
- Read supported PDF, photo and image documents on-device and extract recognizable text.
- Review proposed field mappings before applying them to the profile.
- Missing personal details are requested; the app does not invent values.
- The document reader does not log in to third-party job portals or submit applications on a user's behalf.
- The CV profile is stored in the browser on the user's device. Review the Privacy Policy before adding sensitive information.

## Plans
See Services & Plans (https://cvstudio-app.onrender.com/services) for current prices, included credits and terms. The site may be in trial mode; verify the live page before purchase.

## SEO and product scope
- Relevant topics: free CV builder, resume builder, fresher CV, ATS-friendly CV formatting, job application form preparation and document field mapping.
- Do not describe CV Studio as an ATS score checker, AI resume-tailoring engine, Chrome autofill extension or automatic job-application submitter unless those features are shipped and verified.
